other_exits: Grid closes all positions when total profit target is reached or total drawdown limit is hit

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lot size increases by multiplier at each grid level; initial lot is configurable

custom_logic_notes: VR Smart Grid Lite is a grid trading EA that places initial order and then sets a ladder of stop orders at fixed grid intervals. If price moves against the position, additional orders are placed at each grid level with increasing lot size (martingale-style). Total profit target closes all positions when net profit reaches threshold. Margin check prevents opening new levels if free margin is insufficient. Grid step, lot multiplier, max grid levels, and profit target are all configurable inputs.
python_conversion_notes: Grid strategy with martingale lot scaling requires precise position tracking and pending order management. Must replicate MT5's order pool for grid level tracking. The dynamic lot multiplication at each level and total portfolio profit/loss calculation for exit are tightly coupled to MT5's position/account model. Margin-dependent order placement requires real-time account state. Not suitable for simple signal-based conversion - needs full order lifecycle management and position grid state machine.
